claims.claim: The applicant must have a long-term physical or mental health condition or disability.
claims.quote: you have a long-term physical or mental health condition or disability
claims.note: The source states this eligibility condition.

claims.claim: The condition or disability must affect daily living or mobility.
claims.quote: you have difficulty doing certain everyday tasks or getting around
claims.note: The source states the daily task or mobility difficulty requirement.

claims.claim: The applicant must already have had the difficulties for at least 3 months.
claims.note: The sources give an expected total duration but do not state a 3-month period before claiming.

claims.claim: The applicant must expect the difficulties to continue for at least 9 months.
claims.quote: you expect the difficulties to last for at least 12 months from when they started
claims.note: The source states 12 months from onset, not a separate 9-month future period.
